title: Gemini AI Scanner & C2PA Checker: Content Credentials | AICheck365
description: Scan original Gemini and Google AI files for C2PA Content Credentials, PNG caBX/JUMBF, digitalSourceType, claim generator fields, and MP4/MOV metadata.
h1: Gemini AI Image Metadata Checker: C2PA and SynthID clues
eyebrow: High-intent tool guide · United States / English
lead: Original Gemini and Google AI files may carry signed C2PA Content Credentials, PNG caBX/JUMBF data, digitalSourceType, Google claim-generator strings, XMP credit fields, or video-container metadata. AICheck365 reads the evidence that is actually present and does not pretend to verify an invisible watermark when no public detector is available.

direct.heading: Quick answer: C2PA is readable; SynthID claims must be interpreted carefully
direct.body: A C2PA manifest can be parsed and its signature checked. It may also contain an assertion that a watermark such as SynthID was applied. That assertion is not the same as independently detecting the watermark in pixels. Report the signed declaration and the direct file fields separately.

evidenceRows: Container location that can hold C2PA data in an original PNG.
Signed declaration of the media creation category when present.
May appear as a signed assertion; it should not be described as independent pixel verification.
signalRows: Google or Gemini software identity recorded by the manifest.
Supporting descriptive fields such as Made with Google AI when preserved.
Container labels and provenance fields for original video exports.
Separates manifest integrity from local trust-list recognition.
steps: Obtain the original Gemini or Google AI download.
Use the C2PA Validator for signed credentials.
Use the EXIF/XMP Reader for supporting descriptive fields.
For video, inspect the MP4/MOV container before attempting frame analysis.
limits: Screenshots and platform re-encoding can remove C2PA and XMP data.
A manifest mentioning SynthID does not prove that this site independently detected the watermark.
No readable signal in a derivative file does not rule out a Gemini origin.
faq: It can report file metadata or signed assertions that reference SynthID; it does not claim independent pixel-level verification.
What is the strongest Gemini clue?
A valid signed C2PA manifest that identifies the source and creation category.
